description: This file defines the CatalogContextSeed class which provides methods to seed initial data into the database context for an e-commerce application, including predefined catalog brands, types, and items. It includes an asynchronous seed method with retry logic, and static methods returning collections of preconfigured entities.

classes.name: CatalogContextSeed
classes.description: A utility class responsible for seeding initial catalog data into the database context asynchronously with retry logic.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds catalog brands, types, and items into the database context, with retry logic on failure.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogBrands
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined CatalogBrand entities for initial seeding.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined CatalogType entities for initial seeding.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredItems
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined CatalogItem entities for initial seeding.
